notes.title: Update 1.7.0: New Campaign+
notes.content: [p]This major update rounds out Zero Front with the last of the roadmap features with the addition of Japanese and Chinese language support. If you plan to play in either of these languages, I appreciate any feedback as to the clarity and quality of the translation.[/p][p]Additionally, a new option after completing the campaign has been added. Selecting New Campaign+ will reset the campaign while retaining your current mech build, maximum loot level and threat level. This lets you run it back with the build you worked for and continue to refine it with additional high tier parts.[/p][p]Don't forget, Granvir's full release is September 23rd! If you haven't already, you can add it to your wishlist to be notified of its release. Every wishlist helps get the game out there and we appreciate your support![/p][p][i]1.7.0[/i][/p][h3]Major Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added the ability to replay a successful campaign without reseting threat level, loot level or your mech.[/p][/*][*][p]Added language support for Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Features[/h3][list][*][p]Increased the damage of mounted weapons by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of projectile weapons that don't need to reload by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the cooldown of the artillery designator and added a slow passive charge restoration during missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the threat level in the smaller starting maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size and contrast of HP bar bars.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved paint region detection to more consistently select and color connected sections.[/p][/*][*][p]Combined the ammo inventory slots of torsos with dual ventral cannons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added banding to the selected part highlight in the mech builder.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled mech widgets when opening a submenu in the rest interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees can be knocked over from projectiles and explosions hitting their base.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed damaged vitals not highlighting when equipping a damaged part.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss vitals from previous encounters not going away for the next encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unassigned control groups being flagged for overlap.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed burst fire weapons not applying screen shake on follow up shots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed continuous boost legs not consuming the last bit of the heat bar after the initial boost.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hard and extreme difficulty not ending the run when one player dies if the finale was reached.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the HL03/G Loaded Lance appearing in carry over selections as its tier 2 variant. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.0: Environment Update
notes.content: [p]This major update to Zero Front begins the integration of new environment assets. The trees and rocks across the Farmland and Forest biome have been replaced with the work of the artist SquareAnon. They'll be working their way through more of the existing assets and enhancing new biomes.[/p][p]A wave of new tier 4 parts has also been added. All of these parts are available in the 3rd Resistance Support selection of the Zero Front campaign. An additional 4th category containing only these parts has been added so you can easily pick them up and save them to your carry-over part selections.[/p][p][i]1.5.8[/i][/p][h3]New Parts[/h3][list][*][p]Added the RH04 Isseleis, a slow set of T4 legs with leg mounted guided missile pods.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the GT02 Tsumani, a heavy T4 weaponized armature with a rotary cannon and should mounted guided missile pod.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the WV04 Fighting Frog, a heavy T4 torso with a chainable rocket jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the WS02 Reaper, a T4 laser scythe capable of long sweeping attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the GT04 Super Squall, a T4 mounted cannon with twin rotary barrels that never needs to reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the GY01 Striker, a T4 weaponized shield with a laser saw rim and forward missile battery.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the HL03/R Saturn, a T4 lance with integrated thrusters that propel the wielder when set.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Major Features[/h3][list][*][p]Replaced environment assets in the Forest and Farmland biomes.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced all weapons around the staples of their type and rarity. Average weapon strength should remain roughly the same but the variance from the average is reduced.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added an additional part selection to the 3rd mission resistance support featuring all new T4 parts.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Granvir Controls menu with a scroll bar for builds with many controls.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the Resistance Ace progressing Resistance Support options faster when making multiple selections.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller input locking up when using single use rest area features back to back.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controllers being unable to make a selection in the Modify Supply Drop menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.5.3: Armature Armaments
notes.content: [p]This major update to Zero Front focuses on increasing the functionality of armatures and their weapons. All wrist mounted weapons can now be used by the supporting arm of a two-handed weapon. To get the most out of this feature, a new series of armatures supporting grappling hooks that will pull you towards the target have been added. Try out the Engineer or the Hero to jump immediately into grappling.[/p][p]A significant change has also been made to many melee weapons. Most one-handed melee weapons have had the heat cost of their basic attack removed. Alternate attacks and two-handed weapons are unaffected by this change.[/p][p][i]1.5.3[/i][/p][h3]New Parts[/h3][list][*][p]Added a series of grappling armatures. Updated the Engineer and Hero loadout to start with a grappling arm.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a series of harpoon cannons that fire a reusable projectile at the cost of heat buildup.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the GB01, a high fire rate back mounted cannon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the BK03, a four side port torso.[/p][/*][*][p]Added BB02 Legs, a high durability tier 3 leg.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Major Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added the ability to use wrist mounted weapons like grapples, wrist cannons and pile bunkers on offhand arms while holding a two-handed weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Arms with nothing or a very light weapon (knives) equipped will provide a small top speed and acceleration boost.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 50% sprint to all legs with a low acceleration boost and low heat cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a pumping animation to arms equipped with nothing or a very light weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked certain attacks on small and medium weapons to deal less damage but cost no heat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added camera motion that follows melee weapon attack motion. This can be adjusted with the screen shake setting.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Features[/h3][list][*][p]Increased the top speed boost and acceleration of the sprint on sprinting oriented legs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added mass to all held weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a highlight to inventory slots when moused over.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a highlight to the mech builder for the hovered and selected parts.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the layout of the build menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the camera movement when selecting parts in the mech builder.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some tutorial text to additionally emphasize what needs to be done to progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked quadruped leg animations to be better.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the final boss's durability scaling with player count.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.content:

[h3]Major Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Engineer pilot class. The Engineer can upgrade and enhance parts and scavenge specifically for weapons and components.
[*] Added the Hero pilot class. The Hero receives a great amount of supply pods on missions and can specify the category of their contents.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to choose an additional resistance support item on the Resistance Ace pilot.
[*] Added a random healing item to each supply pod.

[*] Added a setting to disable the quick loot menu when opening supply pods.
[*] The quick loot menu will combine ammo stacks when selecting items.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a screen freeze sometimes caused by tracks.
[/list]

[i]1.3.7[/i]

[list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3.1: Boss Balance and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[i]1.3.1[/i]
[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a tracking slow during melee attacks to enemy Granvirs to create opportunities to evade certain attacks.
[*] Adjusted enemy Granvir melee AI to move in an out of melee range over time instead of constantly attacking.
[*] Removed the final boss's backup in the last holdout wave.
[*] Increased the amount of damage the final boss takes from melee weapons.
[*] Slightly reduced the movement speed of the final boss.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed ammo disappearing forever when split and dropped out of the inventory. Split dropped ammo will now return to the original stack.
[*] Fixed the inventory breaking when dropping an item while splitting it on controller.
[*] Fixed ammo disappearing when closing the inventory while splitting.
[*] Fixed tracks being unable to reverse with mech relative controls enabled.
[*] Fixed melee damage reduction increasing the amount of melee damage taken.
[*] Fixed the boss hp bar display stacking extra vitals between runs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3: New Final Boss and More
notes.content:
[i]1.3.0[/i]
[h2]Major Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new boss to the final wave of the finale holdout. Defeating the boss adds its parts to the next carry over selection. The boss will use more of it's equipment on higher difficulties.
[*] Added Extreme difficulty. Enemies are more abundant, the finale holdout lasts longer and the final boss has an additional phase.
[/list]
[h2]Minor Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed one wave from the finale holdout on Normal difficulty.
[*] Reduced the amount of enemies on the map on Normal difficulty.
[*] Reduced the scaling per mission of enemies on the map on Normal difficulty.
[*] Moved the initial spawn point on missions further back.
[*] Improved performance when tracked legs and chainblades are on screen.
[*] Improved performance in rest areas.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some attacks applying ragdoll forces in the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed a bug with excess vital damage not carrying over to other vitals once a Granvir is destroyed. This means single instances of high damage can now trigger multiple lethal vital effects such as ragdoll+reactor meltdown. Overall, ragdolling should occur significantly more often, reactor meltdown+ragdolling should occur slightly more often and death while standing should occur less often when massive damage finishes off a Granvir. Finally, it will be much easier to clear out destroyed but still standing Granvirs.
[*] Fixed multiplayer desync caused by selecting the HC2 Pistol in resistance support.
[*] Fixed the autosave not clearing when returning to the main menu after a loss.
[*] Fixed resistance support not triggering when continuing a run.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Zero Front Update Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey Pilots,

We love all the feedback you've been drumming up to make Zero Front and Granvir better. Please keep it coming and be sure to review the game as that helps us reach more players!

We've prepared a roadmap for the upcoming updates to Zero Front that we've outlined below. Please join the discord, post in the forums, or leave a comment here to let us know what else you'd like to see. 

We're hoping to have [b]Extreme Difficulty[/b], the [b]Enemy Ace[/b], and the new [b]Scavenger[/b] pilot class implemented by this weekend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588942/fce29f5810363f55ac4481b75face99466844acf.png[/img]

Thanks!

notes.title: Granvir: Zero Front is out now!
notes.content:
Hey pilots,

We're pleased to announce that Granvir: Zero Front is out now! As we said before the Granvir demo has been deactivated and this will be our long term demo going forward. 

Progress from Zero Front will carry over to the main game when it releases. That includes the new [b]TK/TG01 Tractor[/b] unlockable tank treads leg part you can earn in the full game by beating the mini-campaign in Zero Front!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588942/d24e134502439ce5096bd388795e0a1efa4df4f9.jpg[/img]

Here are some of the things you can expect in Zero Front whether you're new or a returning player from the demo.


[b]New Players[/b]
[list]
[*] New Campaign averaging 30 minutes per run.
[*] Build a custom mech with almost 300 parts to find in the campaign.
[*] Online Co-Op up to 10 players.
[/list]
[b]Returning Demo Players[/b]
[list]
[*] New faster pace campaign with persistent depot
[*] Tier 4 parts
[*] Respawn after missions in multiplayer on Normal difficulty instead of ending
[/list]

Please report any bugs, glitches, or issues to the forums or on the discord through the link on the store page. Be sure to leave a review of the game as that really helps other players find us on the store!

If you love the game be sure to wishlist the main game coming soon down below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743460/Granvir/

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hey pilots,

Unfortunately Zero Front is trapped in Steam review queue jail. Until we complete this process, it cannot be released. 

Zero Front is ready to play and will continue to be polished and improved in the mean time. Rest assured we'll press the release button as soon as we possibly can.

The Granvir demo will remain available until Zero Front is released. Thank you for your patience. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743460/Granvir/
